about: The Library's base looks (docs/LIBRARY_VIEW.md "The looks"): the named materials every gripper's look file starts from, tuned on real bodies in the stage's gripper studio (the Unitree Dex1, the ARX X5 and the Franka Hand, 2026-11-12; the blacks lifted by what they mirror of the room, env_intensity, after the reviews of that day: no face of a black body darker than the film beside it).  A look file names one of them in "look", or bases a look of its own on one ("base") with the numbers that differ and the photo that shows it ("evidence").  tools/library_split.py writes the numbers into each scene.

anodized-black.for: black anodised aluminium (a motor can, a machined bracket): a dark metal with a soft sheen

anodized-natural.for: natural or clear-anodised aluminium, milled or bead-blasted: a bright satin metal

steel-ground.for: ground or zinc-plated steel (a guide rail, a shaft, a screw head): brighter edges than aluminium, a cooler grey

steel-polished.for: polished or stainless steel (a mirror-bright rail, a pin): sharp reflections of the softboxes and the flags

plastic-black-satin.for: black moulded plastic with a satin skin (a connector, a servo case, an injection-moulded shell)

plastic-black-matte.for: matte black plastic (a textured moulding, a cable's jacket)

plastic-white-gloss.for: glossy white painted or moulded shell under a clear coat

plastic-white-satin.for: satin white shell or white printed part (no clear coat: also a part's own look)

rubber-black.for: black rubber or elastomer (a pad, a grip): the flattest black, no sheen

print-black.for: black FDM or SLS print (PLA, PETG, nylon): a matte black a little lighter than the mouldings

tpu-orange.for: orange printed TPU (the UMI soft finger)

brass.for: brass (an insert, a bushing, a standoff)

pcb-green.for: green solder mask of a rigid board
